en.html:
An armor's eyes do not fail in the dark of night. Still, night is not day, and there was no denying that searching would get harder and ambush more dangerous. If possible, I wished to settle this while I still could.

Not even four or five hours had passed since the daytime fight with the magistrate. That was nowhere near enough for him to put his position in order. Even if he were blessed with unusual vitality of mind and body, he would be only now thinking of moving.

I could not expect to have time to spare. But it was not too late.

en.html:
Kageaki"Where is he now?"
小太郎"Where indeed? Who knows. A busy fellow..."
Kageaki"..."
小太郎"Ho, ho. Spreading your attention round the forest is fine, but do not forget this old man entirely. It makes one feel neglected."
小太郎"I had been looking forward to you, after all."
Kageaki"Meaning?"
小太郎"The game of tormenting the poor villagers had become stale. There is no bite in it, you see. In short, my thighs were going fat from disuse. Ho."
Kageaki"............One question. Why do you side with the magistrate? Do not tell me that game is the purpose."
小太郎"Certainly not. I am not so free of work. I wish I were."
Kageaki"..."
小太郎"Money. A mean little answer, but money is needed. My clan served a certain distinguished house, and some time ago that house misjudged the world and was abolished."
小太郎"Dragged down in the collapse, we lost everything from rank to income. What remained was the ancestral land, which sounds grand until one sees the narrow mountain holding where even millet refuses to grow. Ho, we were only waiting to wither."
Kageaki"...Struck from the warrior register, then. In that case, that armor—"
小太郎"Naturally, it was to be confiscated. I called on old connections, begged mercy from the authorities, and somehow they overlooked it. Then, right after, came GHQ's armor hunt, and all that begging went straight down the nala."
Kageaki"...?"

en.text:
Kageaki"Where is he now?"

小太郎"Where indeed? Who knows. A busy fellow..."

Kageaki"..."

小太郎"Ho, ho. Spreading your attention round the forest is fine, but do not forget this old man entirely. It makes one feel neglected."

小太郎"I had been looking forward to you, after all."

Kageaki"Meaning?"

小太郎"The game of tormenting the poor villagers had become stale. There is no bite in it, you see. In short, my thighs were going fat from disuse. Ho."

Kageaki"............One question. Why do you side with the magistrate? Do not tell me that game is the purpose."

小太郎"Certainly not. I am not so free of work. I wish I were."

Kageaki"..."

小太郎"Money. A mean little answer, but money is needed. My clan served a certain distinguished house, and some time ago that house misjudged the world and was abolished."

小太郎"Dragged down in the collapse, we lost everything from rank to income. What remained was the ancestral land, which sounds grand until one sees the narrow mountain holding where even millet refuses to grow. Ho, we were only waiting to wither."

Kageaki"...Struck from the warrior register, then. In that case, that armor—"

小太郎"Naturally, it was to be confiscated. I called on old connections, begged mercy from the authorities, and somehow they overlooked it. Then, right after, came GHQ's armor hunt, and all that begging went straight down the nala."

Kageaki"...?"

en.html:
...Strange.

A small doubt that I could not let pass.

Sorimachi was moving <ruby>far too actively<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>. That a man should lodge with a shogunate-hired unit, show his face to the occupation forces as well, and act as the bridge between the two was not impossible. Probably it was one clever way of getting through the world.

But people so valuable to a certain part of society are sought out and <ruby>used<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby> by others. They do not go door to door selling themselves. Light work and large reward come knocking on their own.

If the account was true, Sorimachi's <ruby>proactive<rt>active</rt></ruby> conduct was suspicious. It did not suit the comfortable position of go-between for <ruby>domestic power<rt>Rokuhara</rt></ruby> and <ruby>foreign power<rt>GHQ</rt></ruby>.

The claim that he had arranged the return of an armor deepened the doubt. GHQ forbids possession of armors by anyone except Yamato's regular army—at present, that is Rokuhara—and confiscates them.

Most of those confiscated armors are reportedly just stored. Because of language or physiological problems, they are inconvenient for GHQ officers to use, and little practical value is seen in them. But an armor remains an armor.

I could not believe that a mere liaison's request could carry one out so easily. There had to be some <ruby>business behind the business<rt>・</rt></ruby>.

Unbothered by my suspicion, the strange old man was winding up his account.

...Strange.

A small doubt that I could not let pass.

Sorimachi was moving far too actively・・・・・・・・・・・. That a man should lodge with a shogunate-hired unit, show his face to the occupation forces as well, and act as the bridge between the two was not impossible. Probably it was one clever way of getting through the world.

But people so valuable to a certain part of society are sought out and used・・・・ by others. They do not go door to door selling themselves. Light work and large reward come knocking on their own.

If the account was true, Sorimachi's proactiveactive conduct was suspicious. It did not suit the comfortable position of go-between for domestic powerRokuhara and foreign powerGHQ.

The claim that he had arranged the return of an armor deepened the doubt. GHQ forbids possession of armors by anyone except Yamato's regular army—at present, that is Rokuhara—and confiscates them.

Most of those confiscated armors are reportedly just stored. Because of language or physiological problems, they are inconvenient for GHQ officers to use, and little practical value is seen in them. But an armor remains an armor.

I could not believe that a mere liaison's request could carry one out so easily. There had to be some business behind the business・.

Unbothered by my suspicion, the strange old man was winding up his account.

……妙だ。
　
　一抹の疑念を、俺は看過しかねた。

　雪車町という男、<ruby>積極的に動き過ぎている<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
　幕府御雇組に草鞋を脱ぐ一方、進駐軍にも顔を売り
両者の橋渡し役を務める、そういう人物がいることに
不思議はない。おそらくは、賢い世渡りの一つだ。

　しかしそういう、一部社会で非常に重宝する人間は、
他人に求められ<ruby>使われる<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>ものだ。自分から売り込んで
回ったりはしない。わざわざそんなことをせずとも、
軽い仕事と高い報酬の組み合わせが足繁く通ってくる。

　聞いた話を信じるならば、だが。雪車町の<ruby>能動的<rt>アクティブ</rt></ruby>な
行動はやや不審だった。
　<ruby>国内権力<rt>ろくはら</rt></ruby>と<ruby>国外権力<rt>ＧＨＱ</rt></ruby>の仲介者という気楽な立場には
そぐわない。

　加えて、劔冑の返却を手配したという話もまた疑念
を呼ぶ。
　ＧＨＱは大和の正規軍――現在は即ち六波羅――を
除いて劔冑の所持を禁じ、没収する措置を取っている。

　そうして没収された劔冑の多くは、ただ死蔵されて
いるという。言語上あるいは体質の問題によりＧＨＱ
士官が用いるには不都合が多いため、利用価値を認め
られていないようだ。しかしそれでも、劔冑は劔冑。

　一介の連絡役の要望で簡単に持ち出せるとはどうも
信じ難かった。何がしかの<ruby>裏<rt>・</rt></ruby>があるとしか思えない。
　……そんな俺の疑念をよそに、目前の怪人は説明を
締めくくる。
